fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Leans into a surge 3.5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 water damage to everything in it and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Ramming Run
fusions.desc: Drives into a target up to 8 tiles away, which deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Close-Hauled
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +6% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Running Before
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%, and your wind resistance rises by 10%.
